d: Reports of renewed India-China tensions in Arunachal Pradesh have raised concerns along the Line of Actual Control. According to reports, Indian and Chinese troops came face-to-face near Asaphila after a routine patrol in July. Chinese soldiers allegedly returned later in larger numbers and pitched tents on higher ground, prompting India to send additional forces. The Indian government says recent remarks by the Indo-Tibetan Border Police chief referred only to routine preparedness and were not linked to any specific incident.
